 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 2 19-06-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP appearing on behalf of the State.
The submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner is that no offence under Sections 498A of the Indian Penal Code is made out.
At the stage of the cognizance, this Court will not examine the facts of the case.
The petitioner has a legal right to raise all the grounds at the stage of framing of charge.

If such an application is filed at the stage of framing Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.10184 of 2023(2) dt.19-06-2023 of charge that no offence under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code is made out against the petitioner, the same shall be considered by the trial Court in the light of the Geeta Kumari @ Geeta Devi vs The State Of Bihar on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/33428442/
1 law laid down by the Supreme Court in the case of Kanchan Kumar Vs. State of Bihar reported in (2022) 9 SCC 577.
